scope: Demo ordinary responses only. Self-authored synthetic audio, local real Omni and Chromium; no physical devices, human ratings, official benchmark or integrity-hash checks.

configuration.failure_behavior: response_incomplete; cancel playback; visible notice; no successful text completion

coverage: stop/length terminal records, final content and empty usage records
missing/conflicting/unsupported finish reason and truncated SSE rejection
multiple native prefix continuations through one sentence/PCM pipeline
budget exhaustion, no progress, empty output, partial continuation failure
promise repair followed by length continuation and repeated promise rejection
cancel closes in-flight source and releases capacity without retry
oldest complete history pair eviction with original audio/prefix preservation
exact saved request budgets/prefix flags and finish reasons; recorded replay
terminal notice survives cancellation fence; private failure cannot reset budget or leak draft
demo API declaration and non-demo/shift/legacy contract isolation

live_model.service_capacity: production seq4/native; no overlapping validation workload
live_model.limits: Three conditions reuse each audio input; not six independent audio samples. EOS and coherent observed endings do not establish general semantic task completion.

browser_final.scope: Real browser, VAD, Actor, model, TTS and ACK; isolated loopback backend with forced small budget. DOM checks validate Chinese notice; container screenshots lack Chinese font rendering.

preserved_failure.finding: Actor logged response_incomplete but the outbox discarded its tagged speech_error immediately after cancelling the stream; browser never received the notice.
preserved_failure.repair: Terminal incomplete notice survives output cancellation; browser checks utterance ID. Private incomplete candidates publish only the terminal notice and do not restart their budget.

deployed_integration.scenario: Long response -> explicit spoken stop -> STOP_ONLY silence for 3 seconds -> new instruction -> complete reply

privacy: Only code and this aggregate receipt are committed. Generated audio, detailed call archives, browser receipts/screenshots and session traces remain local. Existing user AGENTS restructuring and blueprint edits are preserved outside this commit.
limits: Completion remains bounded by continuation count and context; failure is explicit, not silent success.
Length continuation uses native prefill and may produce a different suffix than an uninterrupted larger-budget request.
stop proves model/transport termination, not fulfillment of every semantic request.
These small controlled samples do not establish real-room robustness, physical acoustic quality or general zero regression.
